rv.q: This is one spiderweb you won't mind getting caught in.
This Group Rep production embraces both its mystery as well as its mischief.
The Group Rep’s Spider’s Web supplies the body but lets too much of the mystery slip away.

cn.t: Critics praise this spirited production of Christie's classic whodunit for its playful tone and brisk pacing, finding it an enchanting and fun mystery that captures the spirit of the Queen of Crime's theatrical work.
